label: Take the Old Pilgrim Road
sourceNote: Source-governed First Road route from Saint Veyra toward Hearthmere Fields.

stages.title: The East Gate Opens
stages.body: The road out of Saint Veyra begins under black roadstone arches and the dull attention of public bells. Behind you, the capital keeps working. Ahead, Hearthmere fog waits low over the fields.
stages.objective: Leave Saint Veyra by the Old Pilgrim Road.
stages.partyLine: Pilgrim Renn checks the straps on his satchel twice, then pretends he only did it once.
stages.zoneLine: A roadwatch runner marks your departure on a wax-smeared slate.

stages.title: Low Walls And Road Charms
stages.body: The city stones give way to field walls, charm-posts, and wet ditch grass. The road bends just enough that Saint Veyra disappears before Hearthmere fully appears.
stages.objective: Read the road before the fields open.
stages.partyLine: Edrin keeps healer distance without being asked. That is either discipline or experience. Possibly both.
stages.zoneLine: Zone chatter says the east road is clear on paper, which is never the same thing as safe.

stages.title: Hearthmere Comes Into View
stages.body: Wheat fields lift out of the fog in strips of dull gold. The Old Pilgrim Road runs through them like a rule nobody living remembers writing.
stages.partyLine: Tallowwick says the fields look peaceful, then immediately distrusts his own sentence.
stages.zoneLine: A fieldhand raises two fingers in road greeting and looks past you toward Little Dawn.

label: Follow The Shrine Road
sourceNote: Source-governed Hearthmere route toward Road Shrine of Little Dawn and Pilgrim Trial Cryptlet.

stages.title: Hearthmere Narrows
stages.body: The field path tightens between low walls. The fog stops behaving like weather and starts behaving like a witness.
stages.objective: Take the field path toward Little Dawn.
stages.partyLine: Renn walks closer now. He does not ask permission. He simply trusts the shield-shaped space beside you.
stages.zoneLine: Roadwarden Ila reports the route passable, with the kind of tone that means passable is doing heavy work.

stages.title: The Wax Beds
stages.body: Old candle wax has gathered in pale seams along the road stones. Someone has been tending the shrine path more recently than anyone admits.
stages.objective: Watch the wax beds and shrine signs.
stages.partyLine: Edrin lowers his voice: "If the road is teaching, let it finish the sentence before we interrupt."
stages.zoneLine: A zone message warns travelers not to ring any bell they did not personally hang.

stages.title: Little Dawn Waits Below
stages.body: The shrine appears smaller than the map made it look. The stair beneath it appears larger than it should be.
stages.objective: Arrive at Road Shrine of Little Dawn.
stages.partyLine: Tallowwick marks the stair on a scrap of paper, then folds the paper like it might bite.
stages.zoneLine: Local chatter thins out around the shrine. Even simulated channels learn when to lower their voices.
